input: In settings.ini add the setting timeout=30 on its own line right after retries=3. Do it with exactly one edit_file call whose old_string is the text retries=3 (just those 9 characters, no line break) and whose new_string is retries=3, a line break, then timeout=30. After the edit, show me the bytes of the [client] section with: od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6
